guide.overview: Flipkart's SDE Intern interview process is generally rigorous, focusing heavily on DSA and system design fundamentals. Expect multiple rounds assessing both technical skills and problem-solving abilities, with a strong emphasis on coding proficiency and practical application of concepts.

typical_rounds.name: Online Assessment
typical_rounds.description: This round typically consists of aptitude questions, logical reasoning, and a coding assessment. Focus is on speed and accuracy.

typical_rounds.name: Technical Interview - Round 1
typical_rounds.description: Focuses on Data Structures and Algorithms. Expect 2-3 coding problems of medium difficulty. Interviewer will assess your approach, code quality, and ability to explain your thought process.

typical_rounds.name: Technical Interview - Round 2
typical_rounds.description: Deeper dive into DSA, potentially including dynamic programming or graph algorithms. May also include questions on DBMS, OS, or CN. System design basics might be touched upon.

typical_rounds.name: Technical Interview - Round 3 (Managerial/System Design)
typical_rounds.description: Focuses on System Design principles and your ability to design scalable systems. May involve a case study or open-ended design problem. Behavioral questions are also common.

typical_rounds.name: HR Interview
typical_rounds.description: Discussion about your experience, interests, and career goals. Questions about your fit with Flipkart's culture and expectations.

key_topics.description: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Trees, Graphs, Hash Tables. Sorting and Searching algorithms. Dynamic Programming is crucial. Practice on LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks.
Relational databases, SQL queries (joins, aggregations), database design, normalization. Understanding of indexing is important.
Processes, Threads, Memory Management, Concurrency, Synchronization, Deadlocks. Basic understanding of file systems.
TCP/IP model, HTTP, DNS, basic networking concepts. Understanding of common network protocols.
Concepts like inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, abstraction. Design patterns are a plus.
Basic system design principles, scalability, load balancing, caching. Be prepared to design simple systems like URL shorteners or rate limiters.
Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, and verbal ability. Practice with previous year papers and online resources.

preparation_timeline.focus: Data Structures and Algorithms fundamentals. Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Trees.
Advanced DSA: Graphs, Dynamic Programming, Hash Tables. DBMS basics.
OS, CN, OOP concepts. System Design fundamentals.
Mock Interviews and Revision. Practice solving problems under time constraints.

tips: Clearly articulate your thought process while solving problems. Explain your approach before coding.
Write clean, readable, and well-commented code.
Be prepared to discuss the time and space complexity of your solutions.
Ask clarifying questions to ensure you understand the problem statement completely.
Show enthusiasm and a willingness to learn.
red_flags: Inability to explain your code or approach.
Poor coding style and lack of comments.
Getting stuck on basic DSA problems.
Lack of understanding of fundamental concepts.
Negative attitude or unwillingness to take feedback.
guide.salary_negotiation: Research average intern salaries at Flipkart and similar companies. Be confident in your skills and experience, but also be realistic. Be prepared to justify your desired salary based on your qualifications and contributions. Don't be afraid to negotiate, but maintain a professional and respectful tone.
